title: Audit slot link details (v1)
description: Match ↔ slot linkage on the tournament identified by the audit row's entity_id: acceptance links, organizer attach/detach, and cascade voids. For voids the origin carries the chain — the match edit that triggered it (origin_kind match-edit, origin_id = match id) or the upstream slot whose outcome change cascaded (origin_kind cascade, origin_id = slot id).
